name: ToMe (Token Merging, tomesd port)
plain: Merges similar self-attention query tokens before attention and restores them after, so fewer queries run. Speeds up sampling at some detail cost. Only runs on the highest-resolution attention blocks, and the core port leaves keys and values at full length.
math:
Each 2×2 cell randomly gives one dst token; the rest are src. Similarity = cosine(src,dst) on q. r=int(N·ratio) src tokens with the highest best-match score are merged by mean into their dst (scatter_reduce); others stay.
Unmerge copies dst values back into the merged src positions.
Only when downsample = ceil(√(H·W // N)) ≤ 1. Comfy uses q as the metric where upstream uses block input x (comment at line 167).

props.architectures: UNet attn1. Any model with original_shape of 4 dims b,c,h,w (get_functions unpacks 4 values), so 3D latents raise.

providers.author: ltdrdata
providers.note: name match only, installer pack; not read

label: from code
surprise: Core returns m(q), k, v: only the queries merge, keys and values stay full length, a difference from the 'token merging' name. Strides fixed at 2×2, max_downsample=1, no sigma window.
